prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preparing pet desktop environment...", "Estimated completion time remaining"]
1: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Select how you would like your desktop companion to interact with your workspace daily.", "Select Companion Mode"]
2: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Companion", "Customize your expected companion presence before selecting your pet journey.", "How active should your desktop companion be?", "Continue to Path Selection"]
3: ["Upload Your Pet Reference Photo", "Provide a clear photo for optimal 3D desktop pet generation.", "Ensure good lighting and a clear frontal view of your pet.", "Select Pet Photo", "Photo Rendering Quality Check"]
4: ["Background Notification Enabled", "We will alert you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to dock."]
5: ["Right-click your pet on the desktop or use the system tray icon anytime to hide, configure, or interact with your pet.", "Quick Controls: Right-click for options | Drag to move | Tray icon to minimize"]
6: ["Meet Your Virtual Desktop Buddy", "Swipe through to see what your pet can do on your screen.", "Companion Highlights"]
7: ["Official Companion Adoption Certificate", "Your pet is officially registered and synced to your account. You can log in on any desktop device to access your pet.", "Account Sync Active: All pet progress and customizations are saved automatically."]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience", "Create, customize, and live with an interactive pet right on your desktop screen.", "Start Onboarding", "Begin Setup"]
9: ["Pet Care & Desktop Tricks"]
